{{Quote|They should have checked in from the Rishi station hours ago.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, wondering why Captain Rex and Commander Cody had yet to report in|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
The '''''Obex''''' was a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class shuttle]] used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]]—nicknamed "Rex" and "Cody," respectively—utilized the ''Obex'' as their [[Transport/Legends|transport]] during a routine inspection tour of several [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] outposts across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The ''Obex'' first brought the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] to a [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]], where Rex and Cody [[Skirmish on Pastil|discovered]] that a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Rodent (droid)|spy droid]] had infiltrated the station. After the clone officers destroyed the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with the help of the station's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]], the ''Obex'', [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] by Rex, transported the officers to [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], a [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] on the [[Rishi moon]]. However, unbeknownst to Rex and Cody, the listening post had been [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|taken over]] by Separatist [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] and, when Rex landed the ''Obex'' on the station's landing pad and disembarked from the [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]], the two clones were ambushed by the [[Commando/Legends|commando]] droids. The clone officers hid behind crates to avoid the droids' [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]]; however, the droids soon threw several [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] under the ''Obex'' and destroyed the [[Starship/Legends|starship]].

==Description==
The ''Obex'' was a [[Nu-class attack shuttle/Legends|''Nu''-class attack shuttle]] in the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Manufactured by [[Cygnus Spaceworks/Legends|Cygnus Spaceworks]],<ref name="TCWTVG" /> the ''Obex'' had [[Life support/Legends|life support]] systems, six [[Engine/Legends|engines]], a [[Comm unit/Legends|comm unit]], and was [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]–equipped. The ''Obex'' also had a [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] large enough to contain two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in full [[Phase I clone trooper armor/Legends|armor]]. Beneath the cockpit, a [[Entry ramp/Legends|boarding ramp]] extended downward when the ''Obex'' landed, allowing the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and passenger to exit. The [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle's]] two wings were hinged, folding down during flight and up while landing. Partially [[Color/Legends|colored]] red and yellow, the ''Obex'' was equipped with at least four offensive [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]],<ref name="Rookies" /> as well as multiple medium [[Laser/Legends|laser]] cannons and a double light laser cannon.<ref name="Season 1" /> The ''Obex'' was not [[Armor/Legends|armored]] well enough to withstand the detonation of several [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]] in close proximity to the shuttle.<ref name="Rookies" />

==History==
{{Quote|I've got a bad feeling about this.|Cody, as the ''Obex'' approaches the Rishi moon|<ref name="Rookies" />}}
[[File:Pastil-TCWWC05p01.png|thumb|left|250px|The ''Obex'' on Pastil]]
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> during the Clone Wars, the ''Obex'' was used by [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|CT-7567]] and [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Cody/Legends|CC-2224]]—nicknamed "Rex" and "Cody," respectively—as their [[Transport/Legends|transport]] during a routine inspection tour of several [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] outposts staffed with [[Shiny/Legends|rookie]] clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TCWTVG" /> Rex and Cody first traveled to a [[Pastil tracking station/Legends|tracking station]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Pastil/Legends|Pastil]]. When the two [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Officer/Legends|officers]] left the ''Obex'' on the station's landing pad, they inspected the [[Listening post/Legends|tracking station]] and [[Skirmish on Pastil|discovered]] that a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Rodent (droid)|spy droid]] had infiltrated the installation. After destroying the [[Espionage droid|spy droid]] with the help of the station's clone troopers, Rex and Cody boarded the ''Obex'' and left Pastil.<ref name="Mouse Hunt">''[[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt]]''</ref> From the passenger seat of the ''Obex'', Cody sent a report to their [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]], [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], regarding the successful check of the Pastil tracking station. Rex then piloted the ''Obex'' to [[Rishi Station/Legends|Rishi Station]], a listening post located on a mesa on the [[Rishi moon|moon]] of [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]].<ref name="Rookies" />

However, Rex and Cody were unaware that Rishi Station had secretly been [[Defense of Rishi Station/Legends|invaded]] by the Confederacy and taken over by [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]]. When the ''Obex'' exited [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] over the Rishi [[Moon/Legends|moon]], Cody contacted Rishi Station via the ''Obex''{{'s}} comm unit and was greeted by a [[Commando/Legends|commando]] [[Droid/Legends|droid]] disguised in clone trooper armor. The droid attempted to forestall the inspection, but Rex and Cody, curious about the supposed clone's response and odd behavior, continued their approach to the listening post. Rex landed the ''Obex'' on the post's landing pad atop a large mesa and, after the two clones left the shuttle, they again encountered a [[Unit 26/Legends|commando droid]] dressed in clone trooper armor. Meanwhile, three rookie clone troopers at the bottom of the mesa, who had been stationed at the listening post and escaped the Separatist attack, saw the ''Obex'' land by the station. They realized that the Republic vessel was heading into a trap and launched a [[Flare/Legends|flare]] to warn anyone aboard the ''Obex''.<ref name="Rookies" />

[[File:Obex_on_approach.png|thumb|right|250px|The ''Obex'' approaching the Rishi Moon.]]
Back at the station, the disguised droid again tried to convince the officers to leave. However, upon sight of the warning flare in the night sky, Rex was convinced that something was amiss and blasted the droid in the head, a shot that removed its helmet and revealed the deception. Seeing that their ruse was discovered, the other commando droids, having taken defensive positions around the landing pad, began to fire at the clones. Rex and Cody were pinned down by [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire, which forced them to take cover behind nearby crates. In the meantime, the commando droids threw several thermal detonators under the shuttle, which destroyed the ''Obex'' upon detonation and temporarily stranded the officers on the moon.<ref name="Rookies" />

Rex and Cody nonetheless used the destruction of the ''Obex'' as cover and were able to escape the ambush by [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling]] down from the landing pad.<ref name="Rookies Episode Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode005.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Rookies}}</ref> Meeting up with the stations' surviving clone troopers, the two clone officers were able to soon retake Rishi Station and eventually thwart the Confederacy's planned subsequent invasion of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Rookies" />

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Obex'' was crewed by clone officers Clone [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] Rex and Clone [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] Cody during their inspection tour<ref name="TCWTVG" /> around 21 BBY.<ref name="SW Annual 2011" /> During the flight to the Rishi Moon, Rex piloted the shuttle while Cody handled the communications station, contacting [[General/Legends|Generals]] Skywalker and Kenobi, as well as Rishi Station.<ref name="Rookies" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Obex'' was first mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide]]'' reference book—released [[July 26]], [[2008]]—as the ''Nu''-class shuttle Rex and Cody used during their inspection tour. The ''Obex'' made its first appearance in the background of the first panel of ''[[The Clone Wars: Mouse Hunt]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] posted on [[StarWars.com]] [[October 23]], 2008. It later had a larger role in "[[Rookies (episode)|Rookies]]," an episode in the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series, which aired [[October 24]], 2008. The ''Obex'' is destroyed midway through the episode.

The shuttle also appears in the non-[[canon]]ical [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars III: The Clone Wars]]'', which was released on [[March 22]], [[2011]]. The ''Obex'' is featured in the game's "General Grievous Chapter 5 - Rookies" level, playing a similar role to that in the "Rookies" episode. In the level, a [[LEGO]] version of the ''Obex'' lands at Rishi Station, with Rex and Cody jumping out. However, the clone officers soon confront the Separatist commando droids, and a battle ensues, during which three commando droids appear and throw thermal detonators under the ''Obex'', destroying it.

Although the shuttle pictured in ''Mouse Hunt'' has not been directly identified as the ''Obex'', ''The Clone Wars: The Visual Guide'' confirms that Rex and Cody used the ''Obex'' during their inspection tour, including the flight from Pastil to Rishi. "Rookies" also states that the clone officers went directly to Rishi after their inspection of the Pastil tracking station. Due to this evidence, this article concludes that the shuttle seen in ''Mouse Hunt'' is indeed the ''Obex''. Also in ''Mouse Hunt'', the shuttle is depicted as a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] instead of ''Nu''-class attack shuttle.
